component_decision.rationale: Memory Garden is a temporal care workspace, so its core components are authored around seasons, memory states, and return rituals rather than dashboard families.

primitive_reconciliation.reason: The timeline is the primary work surface.
A seed needs a distinct capture flow from a decision.
A season changes the temporal context of the screen.
Revisiting is an explicit care action, not a notification.
Threads are revealed from a focused record on the timeline.
Context opens beside a record without losing chronology.
Care state is a semantic part of each timeline record.

core_components.name: living-timeline
core_components.role: Primary chronological surface for Memory Seeds and Decision Stones.
core_components.decision_reason: The product is organized by temporal return, not by folders or metrics.

constraints: Only declared scale values are valid: ['day', 'season']
Only declared orientation values are valid: ['vertical']

responsive.behavior: Collapse side context below the timeline on narrow screens.
control_rules: Controls must wrap or stack below 480px.
Chronology and state labels remain readable at every required width.
responsive.container_behavior: wrap, stack, or reflow without hiding product state

content_rules: Show dates as readable labels and machine-readable time.
Never use position alone to encode state.

dont: Do not turn records into a metric card wall.

accessibility: Use an ordered list when chronology is the task.
Focused records need a visible non-color indicator.
accessibility_notes: Use an ordered list when chronology is the task.
Focused records need a visible non-color indicator.

core_components.name: memory-seed-composer
core_components.role: Captures a thought with its moment and immediate context.
core_components.decision_reason: A thought is planted quickly but remains richer than a one-line inbox item.

constraints: Only declared mode values are valid: ['inline', 'expanded']

interaction.focus_behavior: Move focus to the first invalid field or saved record.

responsive.behavior: Use full-width fields and stacked actions below 480px.
control_rules: Controls must wrap or stack below 480px.
Chronology and state labels remain readable at every required width.
responsive.container_behavior: wrap, stack, or reflow without hiding product state

content_rules: Prompt for context without demanding mood scores.
Saved confirmation names the record, not a generic success.

dont: Do not add streaks or productivity scoring.

accessibility: Every field has a visible label.
Save result is announced in a status region.
accessibility_notes: Every field has a visible label.
Save result is announced in a status region.

core_components.name: decision-stone-editor
core_components.role: Records a decision, its reason, and a future check-in.
core_components.decision_reason: Decisions need consequences and a return point, not only completion.

constraints: Only declared importance values are valid: ['ordinary', 'load-bearing']

interaction.focus_behavior: Return focus to the decision title after reopen.

responsive.behavior: Stack reason and return fields on narrow screens.
control_rules: Controls must wrap or stack below 480px.
Chronology and state labels remain readable at every required width.
responsive.container_behavior: wrap, stack, or reflow without hiding product state

content_rules: Never label a decision as a score.

dont: Do not hide consequences behind a tooltip.

accessibility: Commit and reopen actions have explicit names.
State is conveyed in text and icon shape, not color alone.
accessibility_notes: Commit and reopen actions have explicit names.
State is conveyed in text and icon shape, not color alone.

core_components.name: season-lens
core_components.role: Changes the temporal frame without deleting or hiding records.
core_components.decision_reason: Seasons are meaningful periods, not generic filter tabs.

constraints: Only declared display values are valid: ['compact', 'expanded']

interaction.focus_behavior: Keep focus on the season control after change.

responsive.behavior: Controls wrap with the season name.
control_rules: Controls must wrap or stack below 480px.
Chronology and state labels remain readable at every required width.
responsive.container_behavior: wrap, stack, or reflow without hiding product state

content_rules: Do not use relative labels without an absolute date.

dont: Do not turn seasons into productivity periods.

accessibility: Previous/next controls expose the destination season.
Current season is marked with text.
accessibility_notes: Previous/next controls expose the destination season.
Current season is marked with text.

core_components.name: return-ritual-prompt
core_components.role: Invites a chosen future revisit with its reason and date.
core_components.decision_reason: A revisit is user-chosen care, not an intrusive notification.

constraints: Only declared emphasis values are valid: ['quiet', 'focused']

control_rules: Controls must wrap or stack below 480px.
Chronology and state labels remain readable at every required width.
responsive.container_behavior: wrap, stack, or reflow without hiding product state

content_rules: Do not use alarm language for a quiet ritual.
accessibility: Due state has a status label.
Snooze action exposes the new date.
accessibility_notes: Due state has a status label.
Snooze action exposes the new date.

core_components.name: context-drawer
core_components.role: Shows the conditions and connected threads for a focused record.
core_components.decision_reason: Context should deepen a record without replacing the timeline.

constraints: Only declared placement values are valid: ['side', 'bottom']

interaction.focus_behavior: Trap focus while open and return focus to the originating record.

control_rules: Controls must wrap or stack below 480px.
Chronology and state labels remain readable at every required width.
responsive.container_behavior: wrap, stack, or reflow without hiding product state

content_rules: Context labels include when they were captured.
Do not imply causality without evidence.

do: Keep chronology visible behind the context.
dont: Do not make the drawer a second dashboard.

accessibility: Dialog labeling and escape close are required.
accessibility_notes: Dialog labeling and escape close are required.

rejected_components.name: metric-card-grid
rejected_components.reason: Conflicts with the temporal care model and anti-dashboard boundary.

rejected_components.name: streak-counter
rejected_components.reason: Introduces productivity pressure instead of context.

rejected_components.name: calendar-heatmap
rejected_components.reason: Would reduce lived chronology to activity frequency.
